coordinates.units: normalized pitch (0 = attacking team goal line)

rights: Fully synthetic. Fictional teams and players. No footage, crest or likeness.
limitations: Synthetic data, not a real match
Positions sampled every 0.5 s and linearly interpolated

footer.zh: 合成事件與位置 · 虛構球隊 · 規則分段 · 解說區分觀察與推論
footer.en: SYNTHETIC EVENTS & POSITIONS · FICTIONAL TEAMS · RULE-BASED STAGES · OBSERVATION ≠ INTENT

zh: 這是合成示範案例：兩支球隊、所有球員、事件與位置都是虛構的，不來自任何真實比賽、轉播或追蹤資料。
資料流程：產生器建立合成事件與每 0.5 秒的位置，並模擬轉播鏡頭只看得到球附近的範圍；流程讀入資料（ingest），依事件規則切出 5 個階段並計算可觀察特徵（interpret），再產生雙語解說（explain），輸出成播放器使用的案例格式（render）。播放器提供白話／戰術兩種深度、中英文與球員聚焦（personalize）。
本案例的解說由離線規則範本產生，沒有呼叫任何 AI 模型。
鏡頭外的球員位置為未知，不會被補成估計值。防守者與跑動者同時移動時，只描述為同時發生，不宣稱因果。
en: This is a synthetic demo case: both teams, every player, the events and the positions are fictional and do not come from any real match, broadcast or tracking feed.

Pipeline: a generator creates synthetic events and positions every 0.5 s, with a simulated broadcast camera that only sees the area around the ball. The pipeline ingests the data, segments it into 5 stages with event rules and computes observable features (interpret), writes bilingual explanations (explain) and outputs the player’s case format (render). The player offers simple/tactical depth, Chinese/English and player focus (personalize).
The explanations in this case come from offline rule templates. No AI model was called.

Players outside the camera view have unknown positions and are never filled in with estimates. When a defender moves with a runner, the replay says the movements happened together and does not claim cause.

sub.zh: 1 號 傳球 → 5 號 傳球

text.zh: 1 號開球時沒有大腳，短傳給 5 號。5 號把球傳給 6 號。
text.en: #1 takes the goal kick short to #5. #5 passes to #6.

text.zh: 門將沒有把球大腳踢遠，而是短傳給後方隊友。球隊先在自己半場保住球，再一步一步往前傳。
text.en: Instead of kicking it long, the keeper passes short. The team keeps the ball in its own half and moves it forward one pass at a time.

text.zh: 這段結束時，球在後場中路，接下來由 6 號決定下一步。
text.en: At the end of this stage the ball is in the central channel of the defensive third; #6 makes the next decision.

text.zh: 1 號開球時沒有大腳，短傳給 5 號。5 號把球傳給 6 號。開始時，畫面中位於球前方（靠近湖岸聯球門）的湖岸聯球員有 3 人；結束時有 6 人。這段期間，可見範圍內有 3 名湖岸聯球員往自己球門方向移動。
text.en: #1 takes the goal kick short to #5. #5 passes to #6. At the start, 3 visible Lakeshore United players are ahead of the ball (closer to their goal); at the end, 6. During the stage, 3 visible Lakeshore United players move toward their own goal.

text.zh: 短傳組織讓球權留在己方，這段的傳球順序是 1 號 → 5 號 → 6 號。這只描述這一次的順序，不代表這種組織每次都會成功。
text.en: Short build-up keeps the ball; the passing order here is #1 → #5 → #6. This describes one sequence only and does not mean this build-up always works.

text.zh: 這段有 12 名球員在模擬鏡頭外（10 號、11 號、9 號、7 號、湖岸聯 1 號、湖岸聯 2 號、湖岸聯 4 號、湖岸聯 5 號、湖岸聯 3 號、湖岸聯 6 號、湖岸聯 8 號、湖岸聯 10 號），位置未知，以上判讀沒有把他們算進去。這是合成資料，不代表任何真實球隊或球員的意圖。
text.en: 12 players are outside the simulated camera view in this stage (#10, #11, #9, #7, Lakeshore #1, Lakeshore #2, Lakeshore #4, Lakeshore #5, Lakeshore #3, Lakeshore #6, Lakeshore #8 and Lakeshore #10). Their positions are unknown and are not included above. This is synthetic data and says nothing about any real team or player’s intent.

insight.zh: 記住 1 號：這次進攻從 1 號的短傳開始。
insight.en: Remember #1: this attack starts with that short pass.

evidence.zh: 合成事件 e01、e02；位置來自合成輸入檔，每 0.5 秒一筆，鏡頭外為 null。分段規則：球權開始（第一次觸球前片刻）。
evidence.en: Synthetic events e01, e02. Positions come from the synthetic input, sampled every 0.5 s; off-camera positions are null. Segmentation rule: possession start (just before the first touch).

note.zh: 合成資料：事件與位置由產生器定義，沒有真實畫面可對照。
note.en: Synthetic data: events and positions are defined by the generator; there is no real footage to check against.

sub.zh: 6 號 帶球 → 6 號 傳球

text.zh: 6 號帶球向前推進。6 號把球傳給 8 號。同時，3 號沒有拿球，也在往前跑。
text.en: #6 carries the ball forward. #6 passes to #8. Meanwhile #3 runs forward without the ball.

text.zh: 6 號把球從後場帶進球場中段，下一次傳球就能從更前面的位置出發。
text.en: #6 takes the ball out of the defensive third, so the next pass starts from further up the pitch.

text.zh: 這段結束時，球在中場中路，接下來由 8 號決定下一步。
text.en: At the end of this stage the ball is in the central channel of the middle third; #8 makes the next decision.

text.zh: 6 號帶球向前推進。6 號把球傳給 8 號。開始時，畫面中位於球前方（靠近湖岸聯球門）的湖岸聯球員有 6 人；結束時有 10 人。這段期間，可見範圍內有 6 名湖岸聯球員往自己球門方向移動。

text.en: Bringing the ball into midfield moves the starting point of the attack forward. Meanwhile #3 moves forward without the ball.

text.zh: 這段有 8 名球員在模擬鏡頭外（1 號、9 號、7 號、湖岸聯 1 號、湖岸聯 2 號、湖岸聯 4 號、湖岸聯 5 號、湖岸聯 3 號），位置未知，以上判讀沒有把他們算進去。這是合成資料，不代表任何真實球隊或球員的意圖。

insight.en: Watch #6: the player who brings the ball out of the back.

sub.zh: 8 號 轉移 → 3 號 帶球

text.zh: 8 號一腳長傳，把球轉到另一側給 3 號。3 號帶球向前推進。同時，9 號、7 號沒有拿球，也在往前跑。
text.en: #8 switches play with a long pass to #3 on the other side. #3 carries the ball forward. Meanwhile #9 and #7 run forward without the ball.

text.zh: 轉移就是把球從球場一側傳到另一側。傳球當下，原本那一側附近看得到 8 名湖岸聯球員，新的一側只有 2 名，球到了對手比較少的地方。
text.en: A switch moves the ball from one side of the pitch to the other. At the moment of the pass, 8 visible Lakeshore United players are near the old side and 2 near the new side, so the ball reaches the less crowded side.

text.zh: 這段結束時，球在中場左路，接下來由 3 號決定下一步。
text.en: At the end of this stage the ball is in the left channel of the middle third; #3 makes the next decision.

text.zh: 8 號一腳長傳，把球轉到另一側給 3 號。3 號帶球向前推進。開始時，畫面中位於球前方（靠近湖岸聯球門）的湖岸聯球員有 10 人；結束時有 8 人。這段期間，可見範圍內有 10 名湖岸聯球員往自己球門方向移動。
text.en: #8 switches play with a long pass to #3 on the other side. #3 carries the ball forward. At the start, 10 visible Lakeshore United players are ahead of the ball (closer to their goal); at the end, 8. During the stage, 10 visible Lakeshore United players move toward their own goal.

text.zh: 以轉移當下看得到的球員計算，球從 8 名對手附近的一側，移到只有 2 名的一側。畫面外的對手不在計算內。無球跑動時，鄰近的防守者也朝同一方向移動：7 號（鄰近：湖岸聯 3 號）。資料只顯示同時移動，不能證明防守者是被跑動吸引。
text.en: Counting only players visible at the moment of the pass, the ball moves from a side with 8 opponents nearby to a side with 2. Opponents outside the view are not counted. During the off-ball runs, a nearby defender moved the same way: #7 (nearby: Lakeshore #3). The data shows simultaneous movement only; it does not prove the defenders were drawn by the runs.

text.zh: 這段有 2 名球員在模擬鏡頭外（1 號、湖岸聯 1 號），位置未知，以上判讀沒有把他們算進去。這是合成資料，不代表任何真實球隊或球員的意圖。
text.en: 2 players are outside the simulated camera view in this stage (#1 and Lakeshore #1). Their positions are unknown and are not included above. This is synthetic data and says nothing about any real team or player’s intent.

insight.zh: 看 8 號：一腳把球轉到另一側，對手比較少的那一側。
insight.en: Watch #8: one pass moves the ball to the other side, where there are fewer opponents.

evidence.zh: 合成事件 e06、e07、e08、e09；位置來自合成輸入檔，每 0.5 秒一筆，鏡頭外為 null。分段規則：橫向大範圍轉移。
evidence.en: Synthetic events e06, e07, e08, e09. Positions come from the synthetic input, sampled every 0.5 s; off-camera positions are null. Segmentation rule: switch of play across the pitch.

note.zh: 合成資料：事件與位置由產生器定義，沒有真實畫面可對照。
note.en: Synthetic data: events and positions are defined by the generator; there is no real footage to check against.

text.zh: 這一傳越過畫面中 2 名湖岸聯球員，交給隊友，球到了前場。
text.en: This pass travels past 2 visible Lakeshore United players to a teammate, taking the attack into the final third.

text.zh: 3 號把球傳給 11 號。11 號帶球向前推進。開始時，畫面中位於球前方（靠近湖岸聯球門）的湖岸聯球員有 8 人；結束時有 5 人。這段期間，可見範圍內有 10 名湖岸聯球員往自己球門方向移動。
text.en: #3 passes to #11. #11 carries the ball forward. At the start, 8 visible Lakeshore United players are ahead of the ball (closer to their goal); at the end, 5. During the stage, 10 visible Lakeshore United players move toward their own goal.

text.zh: 進入前場時，9 號、7 號、10 號同時往禁區跑，提供了不同的接應位置。無球跑動時，鄰近的防守者也朝同一方向移動：9 號（鄰近：湖岸聯 5 號）、10 號（鄰近：湖岸聯 6 號）。資料只顯示同時移動，不能證明防守者是被跑動吸引。
text.en: As the ball enters the final third, #9, #7 and #10 run toward the box, offering different receiving positions. During the off-ball runs, a nearby defender moved the same way: #9 (nearby: Lakeshore #5), #10 (nearby: Lakeshore #6). The data shows simultaneous movement only; it does not prove the defenders were drawn by the runs.

text.zh: 這段有 4 名球員在模擬鏡頭外（1 號、5 號、4 號、6 號），位置未知，以上判讀沒有把他們算進去。這是合成資料，不代表任何真實球隊或球員的意圖。
text.en: 4 players are outside the simulated camera view in this stage (#1, #5, #4 and #6). Their positions are unknown and are not included above. This is synthetic data and says nothing about any real team or player’s intent.

insight.zh: 看 7 號：整段沒有碰到球，但一直在往前跑。

text.zh: 11 號從左路傳中，找到禁區裡的 9 號。9 號頭球攻門。球進了。同時，7 號、10 號沒有拿球，也在往前跑。
text.en: #11 crosses from the left to #9 in the box. #9 heads at goal. The shot goes in. Meanwhile #7 and #10 run forward without the ball.

text.zh: 傳中就是從邊路把球送進禁區。這一球找到禁區裡的 9 號，由 9 號用頭把球頂向球門。
text.en: A cross sends the ball from the wing into the penalty area. This one finds #9, who heads it at goal.

text.zh: 球進了：西野流浪者 2–1。
text.en: Goal: Westfield Rovers 2–1.

text.zh: 11 號從左路傳中，找到禁區裡的 9 號。9 號頭球攻門。球進了。開始時，畫面中位於球前方（靠近湖岸聯球門）的湖岸聯球員有 5 人；結束時有 0 人。這段期間，可見範圍內有 6 名湖岸聯球員往自己球門方向移動。
text.en: #11 crosses from the left to #9 in the box. #9 heads at goal. The shot goes in. At the start, 5 visible Lakeshore United players are ahead of the ball (closer to their goal); at the end, 0. During the stage, 6 visible Lakeshore United players move toward their own goal.

text.zh: 得分機會來自邊路傳中，以及 9 號從第 3 階段就開始的前插。7 號、10 號也同時跑向禁區。這是可觀察的配合順序，不是射門品質評分。
text.en: The chance combines a cross from the wing with a forward run by #9 that began in stage 3. #7 and #10 also run into the box. This is an observable sequence, not a shot-quality score.

title.zh: 進球背後，還有這些貢獻。

intro.zh: 以下根據合成事件與位置整理，每張卡都能對回事件編號。這是角色描述，不是功勞排名。
intro.en: Built from the synthetic events and positions; every card traces back to event IDs. These are roles, not a ranking of credit.
